name: getresgid
description: getresgid() returns the real group ID, the effective group ID, and the saved set-group-ID of the calling process.

parameters.name: rgid
parameters.description: Pointer to store the real group ID

parameters.name: egid
parameters.description: Pointer to store the effective group ID

parameters.name: sgid
parameters.description: Pointer to store the saved set-group-ID

return_value.failure: Returns -1 on error, and errno is set

errors.description: One of the arguments specified an address outside the calling program’s address space.
